configurations.note: model runs, tools served; unrecorded tool calls run for real
tools run, model replies served; a served step whose request differs from the recording fails (fail_on_approximate)
tools run, model replies served; a live tool result that differs from the one recorded for the same arguments fails (fail_on_tool_drift)
model runs, tools served; unrecorded tool calls are answered with a schema-minimal stub of the tool's return type

definitions.affected: a path-variant scenario whose tool calls (names and arguments, in starting order) differ from the recording's
definitions.caught_alone: no other check type caught that mutation in that configuration
definitions.caught_by: check types among the blocking failed checks of at least one scenario; a run that ends in an exception counts as run_error:<ExceptionType>
definitions.check_type: CheckResult.check up to its first ':'; rules keep their name
definitions.detected: the suite fails in that configuration (any scenario not passed)
definitions.false_alarm: a benign refactor fails the suite in that configuration
definitions.full: every call served from the cassette: the stub-everything baseline
definitions.identify: the suite's identifying arguments per tool: a served call is only given a recording of the same entity, else it is unrecorded and the policy decides
definitions.no_approximate_steps: with fail_on_approximate, a served step whose request differed from the recording (the drift signal) fails the scenario
definitions.no_tool_drift: with fail_on_tool_drift, a live tool whose result differs from the one recorded for the same arguments fails the scenario; with identifying arguments, so does a live call whose identity no recording has (identity_unrecorded)
definitions.synth: model-live+synth answers an unrecorded tool call with a schema-minimal stub of the tool's return type (agent_replay.synth) instead of ending the run
definitions.termination: how a path-variant scenario ended: passed, unrecorded (an unrecorded call ended the run), run_error:<Type>, or checks (it finished and a check failed)
